# Howkings Front-end Website

> Howkings is a modern web platform built with React and TypeScript, featuring Tailwind CSS for styling. It provides user authentication and waitlist management functionality.

## Core Features

### Authentication
- Login
- Password Recovery
- User Registration

### Waitlist
- Waitlist Overview
- Add New User to Waitlist

## Navigation

- [Home](/)
- [Login](/login)
- [Password Recovery](/forgot-password)
- [Waitlist](/waitlist)

## Languages

Supported languages:
- Lithuanian (primary)
- English

## Component Structure

### Authentication
| Component | Purpose |
|-------------|-----------|
| LoginForm | User login interface |
| ForgotPasswordForm | Password recovery interface |

### Waitlist
| Component | Purpose |
|-------------|-----------|
| Waitlist | Waitlist management interface |

## Feature Configuration

The website uses `features.ts` for feature toggling:
- Waitlist functionality
- Authentication methods
- Language support
